items.prompt: What does it mean for a polygon to be inscribed in a circle?
items.answer: All its vertices lie on the circle

items.prompt: Name three regular polygons constructible inscribed in a circle.
items.answer: Equilateral triangle, square, and regular hexagon

Explain why the side of an inscribed regular hexagon equals the radius.
items.answer: Connecting the center to two adjacent vertices and the side between them forms an equilateral triangle (its three angles are each $60°$), so the side equals each radius.

steps: Each central triangle is equilateral, so the side equals the radius.
